name: CH4Oxidation
description:
Tracks atmospheric methane by source and the CO2 released as its fossil share
is oxidised, which MAGICC7 adds to fossil CO2 emissions.

As in MAGICC7, the sink is the mid-step concentration over the total lifetime,
shared between the pools in proportion to their size.
Anthropogenic pools receive the emissions that close the CH4 budget,
split between fossil and biosphere in proportion to their emissions.
The fossil share counts the fossil pool and `permafrost_fraction` of the permafrost pool.

# Inputs

- `Emissions|CH4|Permafrost` (Mt CH4/yr), only with the `include_permafrost` parameter

inputs.name: Atmospheric Concentrations|CH4
inputs.description: CH4 concentration, read at the start and end of the step

inputs.name: Lifetime|CH4|OH
inputs.description: CH4 lifetime against the tropospheric OH sink over the step

inputs.name: Emissions|CH4|Fossil
inputs.description: Fossil CH4 emissions over the step

inputs.name: Emissions|CH4|Biosphere
inputs.description: Biosphere CH4 emissions over the step

outputs.name: Emissions|CO2|CH4 Oxidation
outputs.description: CO2 released by oxidising fossil CH4 over the step

parameters.name: carbon_per_ch4
parameters.description:
Mass of carbon per mass of CH4 oxidised, 12/16 by default

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: permafrost_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of permafrost CH4 counted as fossil (MAGICC7 `PF_CO2FROMCH4OXINATM_FRACTION`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: tg_per_ppb
parameters.description:
Conversion factor from ppb to Tg CH4 (MAGICC7 `CH4_PPB2TGCH4`)

unit: Tg CH4/ppb

parameters.name: mixing_box_size
parameters.description:
Fraction of the atmosphere mixed with surface CH4 (MAGICC7 `CH4_MIXBOXSIZE`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: non_oh_lifetime
parameters.description:
Combined soil, stratospheric and tropospheric chlorine lifetime.

unit: yr

The default combines the `CH4ChemistryParameters` sink lifetimes
(MAGICC7 `CH4_TAUSOIL`, `CH4_TAUSTRAT` and `CH4_TAUTROPCL`).

parameters.name: natural_emissions
parameters.description:
Natural CH4 emissions

unit: Mt CH4/yr
